dialogues.speaker: Echoing Conch
dialogues.text: "Hey! Careful, you can't go napping here. You'll catch a cold. Go on, I'll take over. How is the sea — anything to report?"

dialogues.speaker: Echoing Conch
dialogues.text: "Hmm...? Ugh, I must have fallen asleep... Oh! Uh, don't worry, no sign of the tide coming in so far."
